title: Galileo and the Falling Bodies
tagline: Does a bowling ball fall faster than a feather? Aristotle said yes. It took 2,000 years and a trip to the Moon to settle it.
description: Galileo overturned Aristotle's rule that heavy things fall faster with a thought experiment about two tied stones. Drop a ball and a feather yourself, on Earth and on the Moon, and see why they land together.
coverAlt: A cartoon leaning tower with a ball and a feather falling beside it
